name: USD/TRY
description: The month's average of Turkish lira per U.S. dollar as the International Monetary Fund publishes it (dataflow IMF.STA:ER, period average). Earlier years are printed in today's currency unit, so the figures from before a redenomination are very small.

migration.note: The month's average, as v1 showed, from another compiler: v1 read the OECD's figure through FRED. Over the 321 months both hold, the Fund's average is within half a percent of v1's in most, and up to 3.5 percent away in months of sharp moves (2006, 2018, 2021); 304 months differ by more than v1's rounding (compared in memory on 2026-11-11; nothing was kept).
